name: Chijoku no Kankei 2
source:
A few years after the previous work, main character comes to the former school as art teacher. His habits have not changed, so, a new episode of shame is about to begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
前作几年后，主角来到原来的学校担任美术老师。他的习惯还没有改变，所以，新的耻辱即将开始。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
